storage: Keep in a cool, dark, ventilated place (a basket or paper bag), not in plastic and not in sunlight, for 2–3 weeks. Do not store with onions. Once boiled, keep in the fridge for 2–3 days.
looksLike: Small, whole potatoes, roughly 2–4 cm across, round or oval with thin pale-brown skin. They are sold as a separate pack from regular potatoes, which are bigger and are cut up.
howToPick: Choose small, firm, smooth potatoes of even size, so they cook in the same time. Avoid green patches, sprouts, soft or wrinkled skin, wet spots and a musty smell.
shelfLife: About 2–3 weeks in a cool, dark place.
substitutes: Regular potatoes, cut into 3–4 cm pieces
Small new potatoes or Nainital-type small aloo

usedIn.raw: 150 g per serving (6–8 small potatoes, about 3 cm across)
